referees.quote: I believe that several technical issues should be clarified before the manuscript can be accepted... I would be happy to recommend publication after the above concerns are adequately addressed.
I do not think the manuscript is ready for publication in its present form. I would recommend publication only after major revision addressing the issues raised above.

note: First round is Version 0 of a Nature Communications peer review file. There is no sign of a transfer from another journal, and no referee co-signs another's report. R1 gives no explicit category, so the rating is inferred. The tone is positive and the requests are framed as clarifications. R1 is borderline between minor and major, because it also asks for a quantitative Fermi-surface volume extraction, possible core-level spectra, an aging discussion and a kz-broadening analysis. R2 explicitly requests major revision. In round two both referees recommended publication.
